evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json explicitly reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
Per-attempt capital, gross proceeds, fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, and common-value net P&L.
Complete attempt funnel including signal skips, quote failures, simulation failures, broadcast failures, inclusion failures, reconciliation failures, and failed-attempt costs.
Solana forecast-versus-realised follower edge by leader, mint, liquidity, latency, and exit reason.
EVM candidate and realised results separated by chain, route, gas regime, nonce path, RPC path, and capital-time.
Evidence separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses on successful execution from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
Out-of-sample SHADOW results, confidence intervals, drawdown, tail loss, profit factor, and money-weighted net return after every cost.

Before any promotion: fresh runtime evidence, sufficient independent samples, ledger reconciliation, stable positive lower-bound net edge, sellability and liquidity proof, and execution-failure rates within predefined limits.

proposals.downside_risk: Valuation joins and failure attribution can be wrong if timestamps, transaction receipts, or cost bases are incomplete; fail closed rather than imputing favourable values.

evidence.detail: Default net profit subtracts gross loss, fees, and slippage, but has no explicit gas/priority-fee, price-impact, failed-attempt cost, capital-at-risk, or valuation-currency fields.
Window amounts are summed directly; this is unsafe if a strategy or higher-level comparison combines economically different native assets.
Live recording supplies net profit as gross profit minus gross loss while leaving fees, slippage, and execution_failures at their defaults.
Only executed statuses enter evaluation, so rejected simulations, broadcasts, receipt failures, and their incurred costs do not contribute to execution-failure metrics.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces chain-local and common-value net returns after all costs, with separate STRATEGY/MARKET and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss attribution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independent windows and 50 resolved attempts per chain, including at least 10 execution failures or explicit evidence of zero failures; report native and common-value results separately.
proposals.rationale: Lifecycle decisions should use durable money-weighted net P&L and explicitly separate signal economics from execution reliability. Current recording can overstate strategy quality or obscure infrastructure failures.
proposals.shadow_test: For each chain, replay SHADOW windows with immutable fields for deployed capital, gross proceeds, DEX/aggregator fees, price impact, slippage, gas or priority fees, failed-attempt costs, and a timestamped common-value conversion. Reconcile every attempt to an outcome. Stop and mark the window invalid if totals differ from execution ledgers by more than 1 basis point of deployed capital or any attempt is unattributed.

proposals.downside_risk: Small samples and changing token liquidity can make calibration unstable; per-mint or per-leader estimates may overfit.

evidence.detail: Expected follower move derives from reconstructed leader mean returns with outlier clipping; it is not observed follower profitability.
The gate subtracts current Jupiter round-trip loss plus fixed estimated network fees, configured slippage reserve, haircut, and a fixed latency reserve.
Entry reuses forward and reverse Jupiter quotes, fails closed on missing reverse impact, and caps combined reverse impact and reserved slippage.

proposals.expected_effect: Determines whether forecast edge survives actual quote-to-result friction and identifies whether losses are market/strategy decay or execution/infrastructure degradation.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 resolved SHADOW signals across 20 or more mints, 10 or more leaders, and 14 days, with at least 30 signals in each reported liquidity or latency bucket.
proposals.rationale: The architecture correctly demands positive executable edge, but fixed reserves and leader-history forecasts require calibration against follower outcomes, especially for fast Solana markets where copy delay can consume the signal.
proposals.shadow_test: Record each qualifying and rejected signal with leader-event receipt time, quote time, simulated entry and immediate executable exit, forecast edge components, actual priority/network fees, price impact, and later rule-based exit value. Compare predicted versus realised follower net return without placing orders. Stop the hypothesis for a leader/liquidity bucket if the lower confidence bound of cost-adjusted net return is non-positive, forecast error remains directionally optimistic, exit quotes become unavailable, or execution-failure rate exceeds 5%.
suggested_files: new Strategy Lab Solana SHADOW recorder only

proposals.downside_risk: Failure-probability estimates may suppress rare high-value routes if trained on too little data.

evidence.detail: The flat native-token profit floor is supplemented by an estimated-gas multiple, acknowledging chain-specific native-token economics.
Candidates pass route approval and wallet-specific fresh simulation; successful receipts calculate realised net from wrapped-balance change minus actual gas.
Pre-simulation ordering uses expected gross profit minus slippage reserve but does not include estimated gas, failure probability, or capital efficiency.
Only successful statuses become Strategy Lab trades, excluding rejected or failed attempts from evaluation.

proposals.expected_effect: Prioritises routes with durable chain-specific executable edge and exposes whether poor results arise from spread decay or RPC, simulation, nonce, broadcast, and inclusion failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 candidates and 50 resolved executable simulations per active EVM chain over 14 days, including all rejection and failure outcomes.
proposals.rationale: EVM chain economics differ materially. Candidate ranking and evaluation should optimise expected net value per unit of capital and time after gas and failure probability, not only gross opportunity size.
proposals.shadow_test: For every scanner candidate, retain its pre-simulation rank and compute chain-local expected net value as simulated post-impact proceeds minus gas, protocol costs, fee obligations, and empirically observed failure cost; also calculate return on deployed capital and capital-time. Compare the current ordering with the proposed ordering without execution changes. Stop if any required cost is unavailable, or if the proposed ordering fails to improve out-of-sample total net value and tail loss after at least 100 candidates on a chain.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy based on architecture, configured profit-factor thresholds, or win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: No fresh runtime forensics or out-of-sample executable net-P&L evidence was supplied; win count is not the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax Solana liquidity, sellability, simulation, or positive-edge gates to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades without positive executable edge increase adverse-selection and trapped-liquidity risk.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat rejected or failed EVM attempts as harmless non-trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: They are execution/infrastructure evidence and may consume gas, opportunity time, rate limits, or capital availability.

rejected_ideas.idea: Compare raw SOL, ETH, MATIC, or other native-token P&L totals directly.
rejected_ideas.reason: Raw native units are not economically comparable and can corrupt money-weighted portfolio decisions.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. Both engines contain fail-closed executability protections, but the Strategy Lab evidence model does not consistently preserve every cost or execution failure and cannot safely aggregate unnormalised native-token results across chains. Solana leader-copy has a current-quote executable-edge gate, whereas its expected move and fixed latency/fee reserves remain hypotheses requiring SHADOW calibration. EVM direct-market execution re-simulates per wallet and records realised gas-adjusted results, but rejected executions are excluded from strategy evaluation. STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be measured from successfully executable trades with negative net outcomes; quote, simulation, broadcast, inclusion, reconciliation, or exit failures must be separately attributed as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible from the supplied architecture-only evidence.
